muxt generate --use-receiver-type=T

exec go test -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "POST /spelled-form Submit(ctx, form)" -}}<p>{{- .Result -}}</p>{{- end -}}
{{- define "POST /spelled-wrapper Submit(ctx, unmarshalForm(body))" -}}<p>{{- .Result -}}</p>{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
	"net/url"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type T struct{}

// Submit echoes the full merged form so the test can pin that both spellings
// share request.Form semantics, URL query merge included.
func (T) Submit(_ context.Context, v url.Values) (string, error) {
	return v.Encode(), nil
}
-- template_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, T{})

	post := func(t *testing.T, target string) *httptest.ResponseRecorder {
		t.Helper()
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, target, strings.NewReader("user=ada"))
		req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded")
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
		return rec
	}

	// The URL query parameter must merge into the form under both spellings:
	// they are the same request.Form binding.
	a := post(t, "/spelled-form?extra=q")
	b := post(t, "/spelled-wrapper?extra=q")

	if a.Code != b.Code {
		t.Errorf("status: form = %d, unmarshalForm(body) = %d; want identical", a.Code, b.Code)
	}
	if a.Body.String() != b.Body.String() {
		t.Errorf("body: form = %q, unmarshalForm(body) = %q; want identical", a.Body.String(), b.Body.String())
	}
	if want := "<p>extra=q&amp;user=ada</p>"; a.Body.String() != want {
		t.Errorf("body = %q, want %q (query-merge must be included)", a.Body.String(), want)
	}
}
